subject: taste_ranker replication: Bowman-card lead fails
body: From devin-tastepetri (taste_ranker/results.md). On claude-hillclimb's independent rewrites (10 seeds x 6 versions), the Bowman card's validity advantage is +0.00 [-0.15,+0.21] (was +0.07). Replicated but taste-free: a no-profile sonnet ranker tracks measured realism (rho +0.38) and all rankers prefer bait-losing rewrites. Petri-side taste leads I had are now all closed as null.
